slot_scores.name: cost_definition
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Should the total number of raw pipes used be minimized as the primary objective, with the extra pattern costs considered only as a tie-breaker, or should the total cost (raw pipe value plus the extra pattern costs) be minimized as the single objective?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked what total cost includes and whether raw pipe value is part of the objective.

slot_scores.name: max_pieces_per_pipe
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about any limit on the number of pieces cut from a single raw pipe.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: No explicit limit on the number of pieces per raw pipe was confirmed or incorporated into the modeling assumptions.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about the maximum pieces per pipe, so any later modeling would rely on an unconfirmed assumption about this constraint.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The conversation ended without a READY_TO_MODEL or equivalent final modeling state, and the P1 hidden slot H2 remained unresolved.

summary: The agent clarified the cost definition but failed to ask about the maximum pieces per raw pipe, then became stuck repeatedly asking about tie-breaking without reaching a final modeling state.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.
